author: Joshlyn Resek
body: I will say I was skeptical of buying a sleep course from anyone. After looking through a few different consultants profiles I decided to buy Andrea’s. I had already tried a few different things but they all resulted in my baby crying for hours and still ending up in bed with us. I read through the course and figured I would try it out even though I was prepared for a very long night. The 1st night of using Andrea’s techniques it took about 30 minutes for my baby to fall asleep. The 2nd night I was prepared for another short period of crying but to my surprise when I put my baby down she didn’t make a sound. She fell asleep on her own in her own crib and has done it every night since. One night and she was sleeping on her own! Truly a miracle!
